We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

This job focuses on establishing a unified vision for PayPal's crypto and stablecoin product portfolio and leading its strategic development with cross-functional teams. It shapes the roadmap to balance innovation, regulatory requirements, and profitability while prioritizing customer and merchant experience across digital asset products. The position uses metrics from usability studies, on-chain data, and market analysis to inform decisions and standardizes workstreams for data-driven insights. It also oversees product profitability and manages a team of product managers to enhance collaboration in a dynamic, fast-evolving digital asset environment.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

• Establish a shared vision across the company for a portfolio of products, or platform products enabling development & scalability, with a deliberate and cohesive strategy.
• Leads product strategy development, and develops a clear, executable view of the product portfolio strategy with cross-functional stakeholders.
• Shapes the architectural roadmap and balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
• Champions the customer experience and prioritizes customer needs in product requirements and decision making.
• Defines and uses metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
• Standardizes workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.

Job Summary

Ready to build the next generation of AI and automation capabilities for a global finance organization, using Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and agentic AI tools to drive measurable business impact?

The AI & Automation Specialist builds and operates the automation and artificial intelligence capabilities that Finance uses day to day — across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany, General Ledger, Master Data, Tax, Treasury, Reporting, and the Global Shared Service Centres. The role builds primarily on IFF's Microsoft 365 and Power Platform estate, extended with scripting and integration work where the standard tooling does not reach, and integrates those capabilities with our finance systems and reporting layers.

This is a build-and-operate role rather than a design-only one. The person in this role writes the solution, tests it with the colleagues who will use it, documents it, deploys it, and stands behind it afterwards. Because these capabilities touch financial data and financial controls, every deployment must produce the evidence that Internal Audit and our external auditors will ask for, and must have a tested way of being switched off. That discipline is part of the build, not an administrative task that follows it.

The role reports to the Head of AI Adoption, Process Improvement & Automation and works in close daily partnership with the Finance AI Analyst in the Asturias Global Shared Service Centre, who owns the process judgement and validation side of the same work. Infrastructure, identity, and security are owned by IT and the Global Process Transformation team; this role builds on that foundation and integrates cleanly with it rather than duplicating it inside Finance.

Where You’ll Make a Difference

Build and Deploy Automation and AI Capabilities

• Build automation and AI solutions on IFF's Microsoft estate — Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, SharePoint and Dataverse — and extend with Python or equivalent scripting where required, using agentic development tooling such as Claude Code where it produces safer, better-documented work.
• Integrate solutions with finance systems and data sources, including SAP extracts, reporting layers, and shared service centre tooling, without creating undocumented data stores outside the governed environment.
• Work to the specifications produced with the Finance AI Analyst and the process owners, and raise it early when a specification would automate an unresolved process problem.

Make Every Deployment Auditable

• Ensure that each capability produces its audit evidence by construction: what was deployed, when, by whom, what it was tested against, who approved it, and what its current state is.
• Implement the human review points that the process design requires, so that decisions carrying financial or legal consequence remain with a named person.
• Apply security practice as a default — access scoped to purpose, credentials managed properly, logs written and redacted appropriately.

Operate, Support, and Improve

• Maintain a runbook and tested rollback path for every deployed capability, act as the first point of contact for deployment issues, and lead reviews to address recurring patterns and improve the approach.
• Monitor deployed capabilities against intended outcomes and proactively flag when expected results are not being achieved.

Collaborate and Enable

• Partner with the Finance AI Analyst, champion network and end users to test capabilities before release, deliver user training, produce plain-language documentation, and contribute to technical assessments of external vendors and tools, including integration constraints and lock-in considerations.

What Makes You the Right Fit

• Practical, hands-on capability with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate and Power Apps), Copilot Studio, Python or an equivalent scripting language, agentic development tools such as Claude Code, and integrating systems through interfaces and application programming interfaces.
• Hands-on experience designing, building, testing, deploying, and supporting robotic process automation solutions, including automations that interact with SAP through approved interfaces, SAP GUI scripting, or equivalent methods. Experience should include appropriate controls, logging, documentation, exception handling, and rollback procedures.
• Comfortable working with finance data structures, reconciling outputs against a source, and recognising when a result is wrong even when it appears plausible.
• Security and audit mindset, treating access control, credential management, logging, and audit trails as an integral part of the build process rather than a subsequent checklist.
• Strong focus on documentation, including written runbooks, rollback procedures, and plain-language descriptions, with the view that a capability without documentation is unfinished.
• Works effectively with colleagues whose domain expertise exceeds their technical expertise, treating their process knowledge and judgement as authoritative.
• Able to exercise sound judgement, including declining requests that cannot be built safely and explaining the rationale in terms the requester accepts.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• Minimum of 3 years' experience building automation, integration or data solutions in a business environment, including at least 1 year working with artificial intelligence or large language model-based tooling in genuine production environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and fluent English (Spanish an advantage).

How You Would Stand Out

• Experience managing business-critical RPA solutions in production, including incident resolution, controlled changes, recovery or rollback, and post-incident reviews. Experience with Power Automate Desktop, UiPath, Blue Prism, Excel VBA, or SAP-connected automation is particularly valuable.
• Experience working in a regulated or audited environment, such as financial services, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, insurance, or a listed multinational organization.
• Direct exposure to finance processes, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, or period close activities.

Why Choose Us?

IFF offers an attractive compensation and benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and work-life balance, including:

• Comprehensive medical coverage for you, with optional coverage for your family.
• Pension plan to help build your long-term financial security.
• Life and accident/disability insurance.

jobs.description: The Creative Agency Team (CAT) is Gameloft’s internal creative agency, responsible for producing marketing and user acquisition assets for games across multiple studios and regions. Reporting directly to the CAT Lead, the Creative Project Manager is responsible for ensuring the efficient flow of creative production activities across projects. This role acts as a central point of coordination between the CAT team and its stakeholders, helping to ensure that work is clearly briefed, properly planned, well tracked, and delivered on time. The Creative Project Manager plays a key role in enabling smooth production by reviewing incoming briefs and requests, confirming production readiness before kick-off, managing timelines and priorities, and supporting the team throughout all stages of the creative process. This person partners closely with the CAT Lead to maintain strong organization, facilitate communication, anticipate production needs, and improve team efficiency through better workflows, planning, and documentation. Key Responsibilities Manage creative projects end-to-end , coordinating timelines, milestones, deliverables, feedback rounds and approvals to ensure work is delivered on time and to expectations. Coordinate stakeholders and production teams , acting as a central point of contact between the Creative Agency Team, artists, marketing, UA, game teams, legal, licensors and external partners. Drive production planning and prioritisation , partnering with the CAT Lead to define priorities, allocate work, manage dependencies and proactively identify and resolve blockers and risks. Oversee project tracking and workflows , maintaining accurate project plans, schedules, task assignments and progress tracking in Airtable, while continuously improving production visibility and efficiency. Support creative quality and delivery , ensuring briefs and assets are production-ready, feedback is clearly communicated, and final deliverables meet project requirements, creative expectations and brand guidelines. Improve processes and ways of working , developing documentation, templates and best practices, analysing production data, and collaborating with other Creative Project Managers to drive consistency and efficiency across teams. What success will look like Production readiness: Creative requests are clearly defined and production-ready before kickoff, with briefs, assets, owners, timelines, and approvals in place. Reliable delivery: Projects are well planned, tracked, and delivered against agreed milestones, with dependencies, feedback, approvals, and risks anticipated early. Visibility & risk management: The CAT Lead, artists, and stakeholders have clear visibility of priorities, progress, blockers, and delivery risks, with issues addressed proactively. Strong collaboration: Communication with artists and key stakeholders is clear, structured, and proactive, keeping expectations aligned throughout production. Operational efficiency: Workflows, tools, documentation, and reporting are organised and continuously improved to increase visibility, consistency, and efficiency. Overall: The Creative Project Manager provides the structure and support needed for the team to focus on creative quality while ensuring projects are delivered reliably and stakeholders remain confident. What you need to succeed University degree in project management, production, communication, business, or a related field. Minimum 4 years of experience in creative project management, production coordination, or content production, ideally within the video game industry, a creative agency environment, or visual asset production pipelines. Strong experience managing multiple projects, stakeholders, deadlines, and feedback loops in a fast-paced environment. Experience with production management and collaboration tools such as Airtable, Jira, Trello, Monday.com, or equivalent systems. Ability to review briefs and production needs with rigor and identify missing information before production begins. Strong organizational and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage shifting priorities and tight deadlines. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to work cross-functionally and maintain productive relationships with multiple stakeholders. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain structure across complex production environments. Proactive mindset, strong sense of ownership, and ability to anticipate issues before they impact delivery. Understanding of creative production workflows for static and video marketing assets is a strong advantage. Knowledge of Agile or Scrum methodologies is a plus. Passion for video games and awareness of market trends is an asset. Previous experience managing complex productions such as trailers, campaigns, or multi-step approval workflows is an asset Desirable Experience working within a Creative Agency or in-house creative department. Experience supporting multidisciplinary creative teams including video, motion, graphic design, illustration, capture, or 3D. Experience configuring or improving Airtable bases, interfaces, automations, dashboards, and reporting systems. Experience creating process documentation, workflow templates, or operational guidelines. Understanding of marketing asset production and user acquisition pipelines. What's in it for you Perks & benefits: A flexible work model that supports work–life balance Subsidised car parking Ongoing learning and development opportunities to support career growth An employee referral program with generous bonuses Private health insurance and fitness subsidies Access to employee mental health and wellbeing support Paid parental leave Childcare assistance A dedicated relaxation space, including a massage chair Additional paid leave, including: Birthday leave, Christmas shutdown leave, Volunteer leave, Women’s health leave Free coffee from a commercial espresso machine, plus daily snacks and a light breakfast Friday social drinks with friendly game tournaments A stunning rooftop terrace with river views and a games room Exclusive Gameloft-branded merchandise Life at Gameloft Gameloft Brisbane, part of the global Gameloft family, opened its doors in 2014 and has since delivered hit titles such as Zombie Anarchy, Ballistic Baseball, My Little Pony: Mane Merge, the multi-award-winning The Oregon Trail™, and Carmen Sandiego. Today, we are the largest video game studio in Queensland, employing more than 130 talented professionals across programming, art, design, production, QA, audio, marketing, administration and management. Together, we create immersive gaming experiences enjoyed by millions of players around the world. We are proud to be developing Bluey’s Happy Snaps, bringing one of Australia’s most iconic IPs to life in a brand-new interactive experience. As we continue to grow, we’re also working on a range of exciting unannounced projects that will help shape the future of our studio. At Gameloft Brisbane, people are at the heart of everything we do. Our studio fosters a collaborative, creative and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to contribute, learn and grow. We are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified for 2025–2026, recognising our strong culture, inclusive practices and ongoing commitment to employee well-being. Employee well-being is a top priority, supported by flexible work arrangements, wellness initiatives, career development opportunities and world-class facilities. We actively invest in our people’s growth through mentorship, training programs, industry events and speaking opportunities that encourage everyone to develop their skills and make an impact. As pioneers in Brisbane’s game development industry, we continue to push the boundaries of cross-platform game development while creating unforgettable experiences for players around the world. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you’ll find a supportive environment where creativity, collaboration and innovation thrive. Gameloft Brisbane is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering diversity and inclusivity within our work environment. Driven by a strong studio culture and a passion for creating meaningful experiences, we build games that resonate with players around the world. Ready to level up your career and join the team? Apply now with your CV in English.
